== Card-list wording: "Imperial-Class" (8 November 2026) ==
The PC website card list ([https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] … [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111144021/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2013-01-11]) gives this card as: “Deploy on table. Unique () Imperial-Class Star Destroyers draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise and are immune to attrition < 4. During your deploy phase, may use 2 Force to deploy a battleground system from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. We're In Attack Position Now is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”. The only difference from the release-sheet slip [[:File:VB4-31E-Kuat_Drive_Yards.png]] (“Imperial-class”, Imperial in italics) is the capital C; the rest is the card list's spelling of icons. Whether a capitalisation-only card-list difference is a version is waiting for Bill's ruling; until then the article keeps the printed text and no (Errata) page is made.
